weather_report:
As the night drapes its gentle cloak over Downtown San Francisco, the air holds a whisper of warmth—an invitation to embrace the mellow embrace of the early morning hours. Currently, the sky dons a partly cloudy countenance, with temperatures lingering around a balmy fifty-six. A soft breeze carries the crispness of the bay, nudging gently around five miles per hour, perfect for those who revel in the charm of a San Francisco night.

Come Friday, the sun will unveil itself in a splendid display, painting the city in hues of gold and warmth. The expected high brushes against sixty-five, with a gradual decline in temperature throughout the afternoon. The westerly winds will swirl more vigorously, stirring up the atmosphere with gusts of up to twenty-two miles per hour, lending an invigorating touch to this splendid day. One might observe the formidable marine layer hanging like a delicate veil over the edges of the bay, evoking the quintessential maritime charm that this city is known for. 

For the day ahead, dressing in layers is prudent; lightweight sweaters or jackets will serve you well as you wander through the vibrant streets or gaze across the waters. Consider a stroll down by the waterfront or perhaps a visit to a local café where the aroma of freshly brewed coffee mingles with the salty breeze—an opportunity to enjoy the simplicity of life amidst the backdrop of this magnificent city. Whether it's the quaint corners of North Beach or the artistic vibe of the Mission, take delight in the experiences that unfold in this picturesque urban tapestry.
